note: The logic behind every time reference in the binding corpus. A time reference is scaled (it names a bound kind and the tier or class that sets it) or fixed (it uses a registered window name that owns its length). Add a fixed period here, with its owner, before using its length in new text. Numbers live in the owners, never here. A scaled window (scaled_windows) is a registered name whose length comes from a tier or class column: the name is a bound kind, but a number with a unit beside it still needs the tier or class that sets it.
